report.answer: The structural map engine lives in internal/mapengine/ (types.go, goast.go, treesitter.go, regex.go). Per-file engine selection happens in mapengine.Map -> mapAuto (types.go): by default (EngineAuto) it switches on filepath.Ext(path) — ".go" uses GoASTMapper (go/ast, with regex fallback on error), ".ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.py/.rs" use TreeSitterMapper via mapTreeSitterWithFallback (gotreesitter grammars, falling back to regex if parsing fails or the language is unsupported), and everything else falls back directly to RegexMapper; the --map-engine flag can force EngineRegex or EngineTreeSitter explicitly, bypassing auto-detection.
